Name: Grandpa
Text: Those skeletons are guarding something near the water source.

Name: Grandpa
Text: Three of them. Each one stronger than the last.

Name: You
Text: I'll answer their questions and prove I'm worthy.

Name: Grandpa
Text: Be careful. They only yield to those with knowledge!

Name: You
Text: Knowledge is what I have. I won't let Biringan down.

Name: Grandpa
Text: Go, my child. The fate of Biringan rests with you!
